newsitem.title: USA: IVI Publishing forms Internet pact with CompuServe.
newsitem.headline: IVI Publishing forms Internet pact with CompuServe.

text.p: IVI Publishing Inc said Wednesday it signed a pact with CompuServe Corp calling on the two companies to exchange online services.

IVI said CompuServe members will have direct access to the Mayo Health O@sis, a World Wide Web site that features information from the Mayo Clinic. Physicians from the Mayo Clinic in exchange will conduct health forums on CompuServe.
IVI is an electronic publisher of interactive multimedia health and medical information using online, cable television and CD-ROM platforms.
Its stock closed unchanged Wednesday at 3-1/8.
